svg.aria-label: Shared rewards, credit assignment, and learning curves. Upper gradient means and variances are exact enumeration over four joint actions. Below are four seeds, 32 joint decisions per update, and 180 real training updates. Lines show seed means, bands the minimum and maximum, and the vertical axis the exact expected payoff of the current policy.
